basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Project Associate (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology, Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Associate post on a project-based tenure lasting till March, 2027. Candidates must possess a PhD in the mechanical engineering qualification and be below 45 years of age. The notified pay for the post is 40,000-50,000 (Consolidated). Interested candidates must apply on the application form attached with the advertisement and send a duly completed application form along with their resume by email on or before 21 October 2026. how_to_apply: Download the application form attached with the official advertisement from IIT Bhilai.
Fill out the application form completely with your personal and educational details.
Attach your detailed resume along with the duly completed application form.
Email the completed application form and resume to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
important_instructions: The positions are available for immediate joining. The PI shall not be responsible for postal/courier delay, if any, or any other reason for non-receipt of the document at the specified time, which will result in disqualification/rejection of the application. The decision of the selection committee will be final. The appointment of the candidate will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency, particularly applicable to the said project, as and when required. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance to date is not deemed satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Project Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology, Bhilai (IIT Bhilai)
Application of thermal radiography and artificial intelligence for detection of surface defects in blooms/billets during continuous casting process

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Project Associate position must meet the essential qualification specified by the institute. The requirements for the post are detailed below: Essential Qualification: PhD in the mechanical engineering Desirable Qualification: Prior experience in numerical simulation and solid state welding. Age Limit: 45 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging between 40,000 and 50,000 per month. The position is temporary and is tenable till March, 2027.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Project Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The project aims to develop an online defect identification system during continuous casting process. The defect identification system should be able to identify the defective and non-defective billet/blooms.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The positions are available for immediate joining. The PI shall not be responsible for postal/courier delay, if any, or any other reason for non-receipt of the document at the specified time, which will result in disqualification/rejection of the application. The decision of the selection committee will be final. The appointment of the candidate will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency, particularly applicable to the said project, as and when required. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance to date is not deemed satisfactory.
